items.title: UKM KWU FMIPA UNNES Successfully Holds Creativity of Science Workshop Themed “Realizing Imagination: Building Business & Personal Branding in the Digital Era” – Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences - unnes
items.raw_summary: Semarang, June 6, 2026 – The Student Activity Unit of Entrepreneurship (UKM KWU) of the Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences (FMIPA), Universitas Negeri Semarang (UNNES), successfully held the Workshop Creativity of Science with the theme “Realizing Imagination: Building Business & Personal Branding in the Digital Era” on Saturday, June 6, 2026 , at the FMIPA Dean’s Office Building, 3rd Floor, Dean’s Hall. The event was attended by UNNES students from various study programs who have an interest in entrepreneurship, business, and self-development in the digital era.
